formal.cost: Final spent tokens across all assigned seats, including failures, divided by qualified cards. The lower numerator includes fully metered seats and any known subtotals supplied for incomplete seats. Remaining unmetered cost is nonnegative and has no assumed upper bound. Conditional bounds require >=1 qualified card. No cost is defined for zero qualifying cards. No first-phase cost is estimated.
formal.coverage_basis: A4a only. A4b has no independently supplied must-show labels in this analysis.
formal.qualification: Protocol passes AND measured geometry passes AND A4a hits / reference count reaches threshold. Empty references and missing counts make coverage unknown. A known failed condition settles a failure.

method: Historical A4a unique reference-data values, matched against resolved Text content in component order with the original value matcher. Button labels are outside this metric. Composition requires protocol pass, reference value coverage at threshold, and no Text node over four CSS px. Main coverage threshold 80%, sensitivity 60% and 100%. Independent must-show A4b and business delivery are not scored.
